outcomes.statement_hy: ներկայացնել  զանգվածը՝ որպես մարմնի իներտության չափ,(Հ8, Հ9)
կատարել նյութի խտության, մարմնի զանգվածի և ծավալի չափումներ, վերլուծել արդյունքները, կազմել աղյուսակներ, ներկայացնել փորձի արդյունքները,(Հ4, Հ28, Հ29)
ներկայացնել ուժը՝ որպես փոխազդեցության քանակական չափ,(Հ9)
սահմանել ՄՀ-ում ուժի չափման միավորը,  բերել մեկ նյուտոն ուժի օրինակ,(Հ9)
հաշվել ծանրության ուժը՝ իմանալով մարմնի զանգվածը,(Հ9)
ներկայացնել դեֆորմացիաների տեսակները, բերել օրինակներ,(Հ9, Հ28,Հ29)
տարբերակել մարմնի զանգվածը, ծանրության ուժը և մարմնի կշիռը,(Հ8)
ներկայացնել շփման ուժը, շփման առաջացման պատճառները, շփման տեսակները, բերել օրինակներ շփման ուժի օգտակար և վնասակար ազդեցությունների մասին, (Հ8, Հ28)
որոշել մի ուղղով ուղղված ուժերի համազորը,(Հ7)
1) մեկնաբանել փոխազդեցության (ուժի) և շարժման վիճակի փոփոխության միջև պատճառահետևանքային կապերը և կիրառել դրանք շրջապատում հանդիպող շարժումները նկարագրելիս
2) մեկնաբանել ծանրության ուժը՝ որպես տիեզերական ձգողության ուժի օրինակ

skills.name_hy: Մարմինների փոխազդեցությունը, ուժը և նրա միավորը
Շփման ուժի տեսակները, պատճառները և դերը

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Initially stationary bodies push apart; compare their masses from the stated speed changes.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Same interaction and initial rest must be explicit; do not generalize from unrelated moving objects.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Read a balanced equal-arm scale, including the container mass when supplied.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Separate mass from force and from a scale-only Chapter I duplicate.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare homogeneous solid samples of equal volume from mass data.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Same conditions; no holes or composite bodies; do not confuse a larger sample with a denser material.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Predict density when a homogeneous sample is divided without changing its state or temperature.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Mass and volume both change; distinguish reasoning from memorized density definitions.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Convert a density while converting both mass and cubic-volume units.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: A units-only variant overlaps U01-S07; retain only if density understanding adds evidence.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Calculate density from supplied mass and volume, then compare with a supplied reference table.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Describe the matching entry among given candidates; density alone need not uniquely identify every real substance.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Choose dimensions or water displacement for a specified solid, then link the result to its mass and density.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: For immersion specify nonporous insoluble solid, complete submersion and no trapped air; compare U01-S10.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Find a mistaken volume or unit in a density investigation table and explain its consequence.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: MCQ interpretation does not show the student performed the measurements.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Read magnitude, direction and application point using textbook figure 48.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: The public figure is teaching-exposed; no new protected coverage claim.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Connect the taught one-kilogram, one-second speed-change example to the unit newton.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Use the stated one-dimensional example; do not require acceleration notation or untaught F=ma algebra.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Calculate gravity force after converting grams to kilograms.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: State g explicitly and check the unit N; arithmetic-only variants are not new reasoning.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Use supplied density and solid volume to obtain mass and then gravity force.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: All units and material assumptions explicit; avoid p.69 problem 4 arithmetic.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Ի՞նչ է մնում ազդեցությունը վերացնելուց հետո
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Classify a deformation from the observed recovery after unloading.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Material name alone does not determine whether this particular deformation is elastic.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Compare shape/size changes in a stated compression and stretching situation.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Do not confuse the geometric type with whether the deformation is reversible.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Subtract unloaded length before applying F=kx in the stated linear range.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Use the same spring and distinguish x from final length.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Interpret several load-extension measurements and select a justified proportionality conclusion.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Finite measured agreement within instrument precision is evidence, not proof for all extensions; actual performance remains separate.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Choose the unloaded reference and sequence for calibrating a spring gauge.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Zero position and permitted range matter; do not overload the instrument.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Read a calibrated gauge whose marked force intervals are supplied.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Compare U01-S08; a mere reskin of its scale question adds no distinct evidence.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Ո՞ր մարմնի վրա է ազդում ուժը
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Identify gravity on the body and weight on its support or suspension using figure 60.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Equal magnitudes do not make the forces identical or make them act on one object.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Interpret the textbook situation where a falling spring gauge reads zero.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Explain idealized free fall and negligible air resistance; zero weight does not imply zero mass or gravity.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Determine friction for a block that remains at rest under a stated horizontal pull.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Specify the situation and balance; do not claim static friction is always at its maximum.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Choose a useful friction change in a familiar taught setting and justify it.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Do not imply friction is always harmful or always opposite the object’s velocity in every setting.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Choose a controlled comparison turning the same block onto another face on a horizontal surface.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Keep load and surface condition comparable; distinguish contact area from material/roughness changes.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.title_hy: Ո՞ր ցուցմունքն է չափում սահքի շփման ուժը
candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Interpret the gauge reading during approximately uniform horizontal sliding.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: A starting peak or accelerating pull cannot automatically stand for sliding friction; compare Chapter III uniform motion.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Calculate the resultant of opposite forces acting along one line on the same body.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: State both magnitude and direction; do not add an interaction pair acting on different bodies.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Distinguish rest from uniform straight-line motion when the resultant is zero.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Initial motion must be stated; zero resultant does not alone imply rest.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Recognize gravity as an interaction between bodies beyond the Earth-only example.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Qualitative additional outcome; no extra mandatory mastery gate.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval

candidate_briefs.evidence_intent: Explain qualitatively why constant near-surface g is a limited approximation when height changes substantially.
candidate_briefs.screening_boundary: Do not require inverse-square calculations, planetary constants or untaught orbital mechanics.
candidate_briefs.status: unassessed_candidate_brief; not an item or approval
